items.title: Magnarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: My mom loved music, she was into Tom Jones and Andy Williams

ctx.x: Let’s go back a little farther. Your Italian heritage — any music, was music strong in your family?

Well not jazz music but music was, yeah. Oh sure. My mom loved music, she was into Tom Jones and Andy Williams, and those are two of the great singers. You know now that I’m older I realize that. And my dad was always into show music, Broadway show music he listened to beautiful Broadway show scores and overtures.
